authorization: User requested cleanup of unnecessary dev database and infrastructure. Exact proven synthetic/retired resources were removed; business records and unclassified recovery/rollback assets were retained.

loadTestIdentity.directLookup: PERMISSION_DENIED_OR_ABSENT; not treated as absence proof

remainingDecisions.scope: Legacy migration SQL dumps and historical on-demand backups
remainingDecisions.whyRetained: Historical recovery data; no approved expiry/retention decision. Live rows are cleaned, but recovery copies remain.
remainingDecisions.nextStep: Select explicit retention/expiry for the exact dated copies, preserve required recovery baseline, then use generation-pinned object deletion/backup IDs and independent absence checks.

remainingDecisions.scope: 128 other revisions and reviewed rollback images
remainingDecisions.whyRetained: Secure/unknown revision history and reviewed KEEP-protected rollback images; absence of traffic alone does not establish supported rollback retention.
remainingDecisions.nextStep: Choose the supported rollback window and review positive evidence before trimming additional history. KEEP protection tags remain unchanged.

remainingDecisions.whyRetained: Revision absence and the instantaneous 17-connection database snapshot are not a representative workload/SLO or drain result.
remainingDecisions.nextStep: Define workload/SLO targets and a bounded test window; regenerate only the required synthetic fleet through the guarded fixture tool, then clean it afterward.

evidenceCorrections: The first nonrecursive object-pattern inventory returned zero matches; the later explicit /** inventory establishes 2 migration objects, 30 source objects and 384 scan-evidence objects. No buckets were removed.

The first scale preflight referenced a nonexistent school_id on reporting tombstones; read-only SQL failed before mutation and the owned job was independently removed. Corrected student-ID linkage passed.
Routine vacuum SQL completed and its job was removed before a console-summary int/list formatting error; saved SQL proof confirms success. No duplicate vacuum was run to repair console output.

Subnet IAM removal does not accept --condition=None in this CLI. Secret access was checkpointed as revoked; the exact remaining grants were resumed after revalidation, and account deletion was confirmed by the audit event and bounded live identity catalogue. A direct PERMISSION_DENIED response was not treated as absence proof.
